newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat firms after harvest pressure.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat firms after harvest pressure.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat was trading steady to firm on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, after the recent downward pressure on prices from the strong harvest, traders said.

Maize prices also firmed slightly on worries about Rio Cuarto disease, but volume was low. Soybeans were steady in spite of price moves in Chicago but there was continued concern over dryness in central northern Santa Fe province.
Sunflower trade was slow with crushers' spot requirements all covered and better prospects for the new harvest.
